text: Data Analyst - Internship - Ledger (Paris). The Analytics Engineering team transforms raw data into insights with Snowflake, SQL and dbt, and Tableau / GA4 for reporting; strategic analysis in Python and tactical AI initiatives. You will create AI tutorials for non-technical teams, handle data requests, reduce technical debt in core models and industrialize causal impact analyses in Python. We look for a Master's student (M2) in Data Science, strong SQL and Python for statistical analysis and Machine Learning, dbt and Tableau experience, curiosity for Generative AI, autonomy and a pedagogical mindset.
